Delhi building collapse kills six, trapped student sends SOS

A multi-story building collapsed in Delhi, resulting in six fatalities. Among the victims was a student trapped under the debris, who recorded a video SOS message showing blood on his face and rubble surrounding him. The building was identified as a paying guest (PG) hostel. A CCTV recording captured a shopkeeper narrowly escaping the collapse. The death toll rose to six as rescue operations continued.
